<script>
// ── Change this to your actual lab password ──────────────
const SW_PASSWORD = 'swelllab2025';

function swCheckPw() {
  const val = document.getElementById('sw-pw').value;
  const err = document.getElementById('sw-pw-error');
  if (val === SW_PASSWORD) {
    document.getElementById('sw-gate').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('sw-members-content').style.display = 'block';
    sessionStorage.setItem('swell_auth', '1');
    err.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    err.style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('sw-pw').value = '';
    document.getElementById('sw-pw').focus();
    // Shake the gate box
    const box = document.querySelector('.sw-gate-inner');
    box.style.animation = 'swShake 0.4s ease';
    setTimeout(() => { box.style.animation = ''; }, 450);
  }
}

// Enter key support
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const inp = document.getElementById('sw-pw');
  if (inp) {
    inp.focus();
    inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') swCheckPw(); });
  }
  // Persist across page refreshes in same session
  if (sessionStorage.getItem('swell_auth') === '1') {
    document.getElementById('sw-gate').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('sw-members-content').style.display = 'block';
  }
});
</script>

<style>
@keyframes swShake {
  0%,100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  20%      { transform: translateX(-10px); }
  40%      { transform: translateX(10px); }
  60%      { transform: translateX(-6px); }
  80%      { transform: translateX(6px); }
}
</style>
